title: Glacier
notes: Eight slow layers in G minor, nothing articulated, everything drifting.

title: Tectonic
notes: Phrygian and very low; the filters open over sixteen bars.

title: Aurora
notes: The one bright major drone, Surge carrying the top.

title: Mariana
notes: Slowest of the set; a single note per bar per voice.

title: Solar Wind
notes: Dorian, with the delay wet drifting on its own clock.

title: Basalt
notes: Tape and stone; the only heavy engine is Odin2 on channel A.

title: Cathedral
notes: Harmonic minor, long reverb, the sustained-string end of the set.

title: Pale Sun
notes: Pentatonic and airy; chorus keeps it from sitting still.

title: Ferrite
notes: Grittier drone; vinyl noise under eight slow voices.

title: Halcyon
notes: Fastest drone at 80, phaser wide, still one note per bar.

title: Driftwood
notes: CR78 brushes under four drifting voices.

title: Snowfield
notes: Channel E stays a sampler played by the register, walking the DDM110.

title: Tidal
notes: SP-12 grit, dorian, the delay breathing across four bars.

title: Moss
notes: Almost no percussion; channel E is the MSB512 walked slowly.

title: Lantern
notes: The brightest ambient one; major, with a real hat pattern.

title: Rainshadow
notes: Phrygian, sparse, the reverb wet swinging widest of the pack.

title: Slow Tide
notes: Dub-adjacent ambient; channel E is the RX11 as a voice.

title: Ember
notes: 808 at a walking pace, warmest of the ambient ten.

title: Quiet Rooms
notes: Harmonic minor and very quiet; two drum hits in the whole bar.

title: Long Dusk
notes: Pentatonic, lo-fi, the closing preset of the whole pack.
